text: The assistant added a "follow" (tail -f) mode to the yolo-twice UI, toggled by an `f` URL flag, the `f` key, `End`, or a button, with `followTarget` in `ui/src/scope.ts` moving the selection to the newest step and Timeline.tsx and Graph.tsx now marking the containing turn. It was verified with an in-process engine on a growing fixture and a Playwright script (18 browser checks, 39 unit tests, typecheck clean), and while a merge conflict in `.yolo-twice/project.json` was analysed, the assistant proposed one-writer-per-file splits (moving project.json and source.json to the gitignored cache) but implemented none of them and committed nothing, since the merge is still in progress and the user has not yet approved the split.
